items.q: The nephrotic syndrome criteria are nephrotic-range proteinuria, hypoalbuminemia and extravascular edema; the combination required in adults is:
The hypoalbuminemia cut-off in the nephrotic criteria is serum albumin below:
Which statement about the diagnostic criteria is TRUE?
opts: Hyperlipidemia and lipiduria were previously part of the diagnostic criteria
Hyperlipidemia remains a mandatory criterion in adults
Children need all three criteria plus hyperlipidemia
Edema in the criteria is intravascular
items.exp: Note: hyperlipidemia, lipiduria were previously part of diagnostic criteria; edema is extravascular. (Book p756)

items.q: Nephrotic-range proteinuria by total protein is >3500 mg/24 hrs in adults and, in children:
items.exp: Total protein: adults >3500 mg/24 hrs; children >50 mg/kg/day. (Book p756)
